title: Better copper trims
description: This resource pack "oxidizes" the copper on armor patterns.
body:
**Better Copper Trims** is a refined visual enhancement for Minecraft 1.20 and newer that reimagines how copper armor patterns look. Instead of a flat, monochromatic orange that often clashes with high-tier materials, this resource pack introduces a dynamic "oxidized" effect, adding textural depth and a sense of history to your gear.

Unlike standard static textures, this pack features a beautiful gradient that shifts from warm copper tones to a signature turquoise patina. It’s not just a color swap—it’s a visual evolution that makes your armor look like a weathered relic, perfectly integrated into the world's aesthetic.

Key Features:
Visual Harmony: The oxidized turquoise hues create a stunning contrast with Diamond, Netherite, and Iron armor, offering a much more sophisticated palette than the default copper.

Vanilla+ Experience: 
The pack maintains the authentic feel of the blocky game you love, enhancing details without breaking the original art style.

Performance Friendly: 
As a lightweight texture replacement, it has zero impact on your frame rate, ensuring a smooth experience even on low-end systems.

How to see the difference?
Just compare your copper-trimmed armor before and after activating the pack. As shown in the "Before" and "After" screenshots, the patterns are no longer flat—they "pop" with the rich character of aged metal, highlighting the intricate shapes of every trim template.
Compatibility & Requirements:

Version: 
Designed specifically for Minecraft 1.20+ (the Trails & Tales update and beyond).

Engine: 
Works seamlessly on the vanilla engine and does not require Optifine or Iris.

Mod-friendly: 
Fully compatible with optimization mods like Sodium, as it only modifies the armor trim texture atlases.

Installation:
-Download the ".zip" file.
-Open Minecraft and go to Options > Resource Packs > Open Pack Folder.
-Drop the file into the folder.
-Move Better Copper Trims to the top of your active list and click "Done".
